entry_to_line2_transfer.method: 5D matched paragraph-trained PCA basis; lines with >=5 body tokens; PCs centered within page-side; each paragraph contributes paired line0->line2 delta; leave one section out; train direction from all other H/B/P/S/T sections; uncertainty bootstrapped by page-side
entry_to_line2_transfer.interpretation: The entry-to-line2 transition transfers to every held-out major prose/text section. Biological is weaker but still positive. This is stronger evidence for a shared paragraph-entry dynamic than the earlier within-section cosine comparison, though it remains development evidence on the same manuscript.

paragraph_residualization.substrate: 635 paragraphs with >=20 body tokens; each fingerprint is the mean of 10 random contiguous 20-token windows

split_half_reliability.interpretation: Matched paragraph fingerprints are highly repeatable; residual variance cannot be dismissed mainly as 20-token sampling noise.

model_metadata_only.predictors: section + Currier + hand + normalized paragraph ordinal

model_metadata_plus_page_context.predictors: metadata + leave-one-paragraph-out mean fingerprint of other paragraphs on the same page-side

paragraph_residualization.interpretation: Known broad metadata and leave-one-paragraph-out page context explain only a minority of stable paragraph-level structural variance. The largest residual axis is almost independent of section/Currier/hand, although a modest same-page residual similarity remains. These cross-fitted residuals are a candidate future target, not yet evidence of semantics or cipher information.

decision: H56-4 remains OPEN but now has a concrete candidate residual. The shared paragraph-entry trajectory is transferable across major sections; after removing broad metadata and page-local context, substantial reliable paragraph-specific variation remains. Before semantic/cipher tests, residual robustness must be checked against feature definition/transcription sensitivity and against richer but leakage-safe structural predictors.
